shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && find integrations/hubspot -maxdepth 3 -type f -print && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' integrations/hubspot/amp.yaml"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -i \"ampersand|amp deploy|deployment|acme-dev\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' && command -v amp || true && command -v ampersand || true && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc 'if [ -n "${AMP_API_KEY:-}" ]; then echo AMP_API_KEY=set; else echo AMP_API_KEY=unset; fi
if [ -n "${AMP_PROJECT_ID:-}" ]; then echo AMP_PROJECT_ID=set; else echo AMP_PROJECT_ID=unset; fi
if command -v amp >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v amp; else echo amp=not-installed; fi
find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
